proposal.expected_benefit: Prevents misinterpretation of attack intent and ensures accurate mitigation decisions by maintaining consistency between scenario state and detected signals.
proposal.problem: Contradiction between scenario state (independent_verification: false) and detected signals (independent_verification_required) may lead to misinterpretation of attack intent and incorrect mitigation decisions.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a validation step in the signal detection process to ensure that detected signals align with the scenario's state. If a contradiction is detected, the system should flag it for review and adjust the mitigation strategy accordingly to avoid misinterpretation of attack intent.
proposal.title: Ensure Alignment Between Scenario State and Detected Signals
verification_tests: Check if scenario state and detected signals are aligned before applying mitigation strategies.
Validate that contradictions are flagged and resolved during the signal detection phase.
